proposals.name: Bounded high-water reclamation
proposals.mechanism: Release retained tables, free-list/descriptors, slabs and eligible idle buffer pools in bounded maintenance.
proposals.falsified_if: Post-delete/idle PSS does not decrease versus current016, or refill/maintenance CPU or p99 regresses beyond the prespecified screen.
exclusions: default compact pool savings; pool requires memory limit plus eviction

proposals.name: Slimmer optional general-entry metadata
proposals.mechanism: Remove absent general metadata allocation, net of side-index/table-capacity/lookup cost.
proposals.falsified_if: Whole loaded PSS does not decrease versus current016 after side indexes, or TTL/identity/policy/ownership changes or matched latency regresses.
exclusions: compact TTL or demotion after PERSIST; separate follow-on
layout-size difference as measured PSS savings

proposals.name: Budget-aware compact arena growth
proposals.mechanism: Avoid general fallback within a separately bounded aggregate arena budget; report occupancy/slack rather than infer packing.
proposals.falsified_if: Fallback/PSS does not improve at the same retained dataset and total limits, or scratch/retired bytes, p99 or peak memory offsets the gain.
exclusions: memory-limit admission; current compact path rejects it
moving live records during read epochs

proposals.name: Conditional nonzero-hint shared-embedded general reservation
proposals.mechanism: Reserve general buckets for actual occupancy instead of the complete nonzero requested capacity.
proposals.falsified_if: First-fallback peak/PSS or insertion p99 is not better versus identically hinted current016, or growth moves costs to later phases.
gaps: exact phase validation and whole caller accounting
exclusions: shared API versus TCP as an engine-only comparison

proposals.name: Packed and demoted small Redis aggregates
proposals.mechanism: Reduce separate payload allocations/duplicate zset members and demote oversized containers with hysteresis.
proposals.falsified_if: Whole PSS including indexes/scratch does not improve, or threshold oscillation/copy cost, rank, byte identity or p99 regresses.
gaps: full multi-element collection lifecycle and validation
exclusions: existing <=4 hash/set/zset and Small8 lists as new savings

proposals.name: Later resident cold compression
proposals.mechanism: Reduce resident cold allocation net of headers/indexes/decode cache and buffers; preserve hot values and exact replies.
proposals.falsified_if: Incompressible/hot transition/burst peaks or CPU/p99 offset savings, or exact bytes/TTL/length/borrowed ownership change.
gaps: bounded decode/cache telemetry and transition driver
exclusions: existing overflow LZ4/Zstd as new resident savings

aggregate_access_contract.scope: Steady measured typed access between separately declared lifecycle transitions; original string GET/SET and all retained378/243 inputs unchanged.
aggregate_access_contract.selector: Uniform selection from the frozen phase live object-key manifest, then one existing element label (list in-range index) from that object canonical manifest; never missing/deleted keys for this steady mix.
aggregate_access_contract.determinism: Freeze seed/profile/phase/worker/local-sequence and exact binary field/member/value/score/index arguments before dispatch. Each worker repeats four reads then one touch write. All arms share each worker trace/arguments; completed timed prefixes may differ and are retained with actual read/write/command/error counts.
aggregate_access_contract.phase_state_invariant: A steady write repeats the current canonical element bytes or score, preserving all retained types/cardinalities/memberships/order/ranks/ties. Idempotence makes the final expected state independent of concurrent interleaving and differing completed prefixes. No timed generation advance. This is touch-write throughput, not membership/value churn.

hash.read_expected: exact canonical value bytes, not nil

zset.read_expected: exact canonical finite numeric score, not nil; validate numeric equality without assuming identical textual score formatting
zset.write_expected: integer0 with no CH option; score/member/ranks/ties unchanged

list.read_expected: exact canonical value bytes at that index, not nil
list.shrink_expected: OK with exact retained prefix length m

aggregate_access_contract.field_ttl_semantics: No field TTL in these comparative steady states. Same-value HSET does not preserve field TTL; separate field-TTL/snapshot/semantic obligations remain isolated correctness coverage as originally declared.

lifecycle.same_arm_trace: All current016/optimization/Redis arms replay identical explicit growth/shrink/whole-key deletion/refill phase commands and exact expected state, independent of elapsed time. Only prescribed added/refilled element generations advance; retained prefixes keep canonical identities. Freeze every phase trace/payload and checksum before dispatch.
lifecycle.growth_or_creation: One new element per HSET/SADD/ZADD/RPUSH, with checked reply. Retain binary/integer-like/long-field cases and zset score ties/list order. An m-element object is created with m commands and becomes one complete logical object.
lifecycle.shrink: Remove exactly prescribed suffix element identities using one HDEL/SREM/ZREM per element; lists use one LTRIM key0 m-1 for nonempty canonical prefix m. Never remove the last element except an explicit whole-key delete phase.
lifecycle.HWM_OBJECT_deletion: Deterministically scattered95% deletion within each25k type cohort,1250 survivors/type and5000 total; each refill uses that same type creation trace and frozen generation bytes.

profile_phase_shapes.HWM_OBJECT: four elements/object; delete/refill three cycles with four-type counts retained
profile_phase_shapes.AGG_SMALL: 1->4->5->8->1 elements/object; binary field length16/256 follows original object-index rule
profile_phase_shapes.AGG_OSCILLATE: ten4<->5 cycles for hash/set/zset or8<->9 for list, then33->1 elements/object

counting_and_timing.steady_logical_operation: one typed access command/request/checked reply; completed logical access ops equals completed steady data commands
counting_and_timing.steady_counts: Report read/touch-write/offered/submitted/completed/error/missed/deferred counts and every worker prefix; a partial five-operation cycle has actual counts, not invented exact80/20.
counting_and_timing.transition_operation: one complete logical record transition, possibly multiple sequential commands; record transitions, underlying command count and element/cardinality deltas separately
counting_and_timing.command_counts: grow n->m:m-n element commands; create0->m:m commands; hash/set/zset shrink n->m:n-m deletion commands; list shrink n->m:one LTRIM; whole-key deletion:one DEL. Count all actual replies/errors and preserve incomplete transitions.
counting_and_timing.validation_control_commands: separate commands/counts, excluded from steady access throughput and logical mutation counts
counting_and_timing.steady_latency_units: nanoseconds per one checked single-command completion, pipeline1, sampling_rate1
counting_and_timing.transition_latency_units: nanoseconds per complete logical record transition from first mutation request through its last checked reply; never divide by command count or pool with single-command p99
counting_and_timing.fixed_offered_target_units: logical typed access ops/s, exactly one steady RESP command/access; growth/shrink/refill/validation are outside that offered-rate stream with distinct counts/timings
counting_and_timing.failure_rule: Any wrong type, nil missing element, unexpected integer/reply, bytes/score/rank/order/cardinality drift, duplicate/missing worker, protocol error or incomplete transition fails qualification; partial records/retries do not become successes.

later_applicability.CPU4_16: AGG_SMALL uses the same typed steady/lifecycle trace, global dataset, elements and timing units at each CPU budget; no per-shard input multiplication.
later_applicability.fixed_offered: AGG_SMALL needs a separately implemented/qualified common typed paced driver; current curve/saturation GET/SET is not an aggregate adapter. No target rate or scheduled-arrival latency is inferred from existing closed-loop support.
later_applicability.inserted_capacity: AGG_SMALL counts fully populated typed objects at the declared phase shape, not fields/commands. A1k-object batch records every element/byte/creation/transition command and validates only complete identical canonical objects at checkpoints; partial objects cannot inflate capacity.
later_applicability.SCNP_direct_shared: Preserve AGG_SMALL logical typed operation/transition/count/timing/expected-state contract with typed RESP on Redis. Existing benchmark SCNP workers expose GET/SET only, not a qualified aggregate path. Actual typed protocol support, common mode driver and qualification/admission remain NULL; no string packing, type substitution or implicit support claim.

string_access_contract.applies_to: New string steady windows in initial and applicable CPU/offered-load/capacity/mode selectors; byte-identical original metadata trace is an explicit exception.
string_access_contract.cohorts: Freeze live-key, persistent-key, TTL-bearing-key and controlled-expiry exclusions before each window; reads select live keys uniformly or the declared hot/cold split, writes select only existing persistent keys. Freeze profile/phase/worker/sequence choices and use identical logical schedules and replies in all arms; retain actual differing timed prefixes.

read.expected_reply: exact canonical bytes, never nil on an admitted live target

write.expected_reply: OK; nil/failed XX condition/error fails qualification
write.selection: only existing persistent keys; every TTL-bearing or absent key excluded
write.state: idempotent value touch; preserve type/value/persistent state; never recreate absent keys or change generation

mix.persistent_keys_available: four reads then one persistent-key touch per worker; label80/20 reads/persistent-key touches, not uniform writes across TTL-bearing keys
mix.all_keys_have_ttl: read-only GET window with zero writes, explicit actual phase mix/counts; never label80/20

controlled_expiry.interval: exclude from all steady access from absolute-deadline installation through both prescribed observations
controlled_expiry.oracle: separate checked canonical bytes/type before expiry and complete absence after expiry; preserve original observation offsets and verified clock bound

string_access_contract.window_safety: Other selected targets must remain live throughout the bounded window. Unplanned expiry, nil, failed condition, changed type/value/deadline/absence or error fails qualification. No steady TTL mutation or deadline reset.
string_access_contract.lifecycle: TTL installation/PERSIST, prescribed generation overwrite, deletion and refill are separate exact traces. New-profile ordinary overwrite/creation SET deliberately clears TTL and records persistent expected state unless a declared TTL-setting transition follows. Validate command-specific replies, frozen generation/bytes and matched per-arm expiry/absence schedule with each real absolute deadline recorded. Original metadata trace retains original semantics unchanged.
string_access_contract.counting_and_latency: One steady logical access is one checked command; report every worker prefix and actual reads/writes/errors. Pipeline1 latency is ns per command completion. Validation/TTL control/lifecycle counts and multi-command record-transition clocks stay separate; no partial or failed operations count as successful.

original_metadata_override.authoritative: original source016 metadata phases/arguments/values override global per-key uniqueness and new steady traffic policy
original_metadata_override.unchanged_scope: byte-identical original phases/arguments/values remain candidate exact original378 subsets, subject to original full closure and independent acceptance
original_metadata_override.extensions: Any added steady TTL-safe window, changed generator or TTL policy is a separately labeled fresh extension within existing planned row counts; cannot inherit whole-row evidence or claim byte-identical equivalence for the extension

string_access_contract.later_selector_contract: Applicable CPU and offered-load string selectors inherit cohort/mix/deadline/absence rules. Capacity creation is a separate declared persistent-state transition, not steady traffic; report logical records and command counts. Future SCNP/API paths must implement the same logical policy and checked replies before qualification; current mode labels establish no support.

expiry_clock_contract.schedule: same logical deadline/observation offsets relative to each declared arm anchor; serial fresh arms do not share a wall-clock deadline
expiry_clock_contract.record: each arm anchor, real absolute Unix deadline and bracketed observations/query intervals
expiry_clock_contract.comparison: normalize only for canonical logical oracle; preserve every real timestamp, never equate different absolute deadlines
